records.issue_text: Stored embeddable host may include a :port suffix but referer uri.host never includes one, so port-suffixed hosts can never match and frame protection is silently disabled for those entries
records.rationale: EmbeddableHost can be stored with a port because the validation allows `(:[0-9]{1,5})?` and `before_validation` strips only scheme and path (not `:port`): `self.host.sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')` and `self.host.sub!(/\/.*$/, '')`. But `record_for_host` parses the referer/url and compares using `uri.host` (hostname only, no port): `host = uri.host` then `where("lower(host) = ?", host)`. Therefore a DB record like `example.com:3000` will never match a referer `http://example.com:3000/...` because `uri.host` becomes `example.com` while the stored value is `example.com:3000`.
